notes: The Store retains only the latest nonempty completed batch plus its original ID order, with page-memory undo state keyed by database name. Empty clears preserve the pending batch; undo consumes it; dropping a store also removes its undo record.

Undo merges saved removed records with current survivors in their original relative order and appends later additions. It preserves original IDs/titles/completion states without regenerating IDs, preserves later edits/toggles, and skips separately deleted survivors.

The Model exposes the Store operations; the Controller refreshes the current filter and counts; the View binds a native Undo clear completed button in a separate row above the existing footer, so it remains reachable with an empty list.
